concerns.text: Phase 0 (Bootstrap) is listed without any FR or SC reference. The spec does not require a bootstrap step, so this task is not traceable to a functional requirement or success criterion.

Phase 9 (CI / Testing) asserts verification of “All FRs” but does not map to any specific SC (e.g., SC‑004 runtime limit). The effort is not explicitly tied to a success criterion.
